policies.policyname: Bank statement lines manageable by authorized users
policies.qual: (is_platform_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role) OR has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manage_bank_reconciliation'::text))
policies.with_check: (is_platform_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role) OR has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manage_bank_reconciliation'::text))

policies.policyname: Bank statement lines viewable by authorized users
policies.qual:
(is_platform_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role) OR has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manage_bank_reconciliation'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM financial_account_access faa
  WHERE ((faa.account_id = bank_statement_lines.financial_account_id) AND (faa.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

(is_platform_admin() OR (id = current_company_id()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_roles ur
  WHERE ((ur.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (ur.company_id = companies.id)))))

policies.policyname: Financial accounts viewable by authorized users
policies.qual:
(is_platform_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((company_id = current_company_id()) AND (has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR can_see_confidential(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((COALESCE(is_restricted, false) = false) AND has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM financial_account_access faa
  WHERE ((faa.account_id = financial_accounts.id) AND (faa.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))))
(is_platform_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((company_id = current_company_id()) AND has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role)))
policies.with_check: (is_platform_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((company_id = current_company_id()) AND has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role)))

policies.policyname: Transactions deletable by admin or manager
policies.qual: (has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role))

policies.with_check: (has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'editor'::app_role))

policies.qual: (has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'editor'::app_role))

(can_see_confidential(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((COALESCE(is_confidential, false) = false) AND ((account_id IS NULL) OR (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM financial_accounts a
  WHERE ((a.id = transactions.account_id) AND a.is_restricted)))))))
((event_id IS NOT NULL) AND user_has_event_access(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), event_id) AND has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'view_partner_transactions'::text))

(has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'platform_admin'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'manager'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'editor'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'viewer'::app_role) OR has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'accountant'::app_role))
